Class EndGamePhase

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.phase.EndGamePhase
All Implemented Interfaces:
GamePhase
public class EndGamePhase extends Object implements GamePhase
Represents the terminal phase of the game.

This transient phase is triggered automatically after the final round concludes. It is responsible for orchestrating the final scoring pipeline: activating end-game specific card effects, computing the definitive tribe scores, and declaring the absolute winner before broadcasting the results to all clients.

  • Method Details

    • resolveEndGame

      public GameDelta resolveEndGame(Game game)
      Executes the final scoring procedures and determines the winner of the match.

      The resolution strictly follows this pipeline:

      1. Activation: Triggers the EndGame notificator, allowing any specific card strategies (e.g., conditional victory points) to apply their effects.
      2. Computation: Commands each player's tribe to calculate its total end-game score.
      3. Aggregation: Collects the final point totals into a single mapping.
      4. Declaration: Determines the winning player based on the game's tie-breaker rules.
      Parameters:
      game - the main game instance ending its lifecycle
      Returns:
      an EndGameDelta containing the comprehensive final scores and the winner's nickname
